# js-dos v7 browser runtime

Downloaded on 2026-09-29 from:
https://js-dos.com/v7/build/releases/latest/js-dos/

Files: js-dos.js, js-dos.css, wdosbox.js, wdosbox.wasm.
Kept on the same origin as the player because browser Workers cannot start
directly from the external CDN. Only loaded when the user starts DOOM.

Upstream source: https://github.com/caiiiycuk/js-dos/tree/7.xx
